llm.summary: This skill is a narrow markdown-only code-review helper that tells the agent to flag unnecessary complexity without running code or changing files.

dimensions.detail: The skill only needs access to user-provided diffs or code context to perform its review task and does not request credentials, broad local indexing, network access, or system mutation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact inspected is a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no install script, bundled code, dependencies, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to review output only, explicitly exclude correctness, security, and performance review, and state that fixes should not be applied.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, memory writes, hooks, services, or tool modification behavior is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: review diffs for over-engineering and produce concise suggestions for deletion or simplification.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe to install for lightweight over-engineering reviews. Expect it to give terse suggestions about code to remove or simplify; use a normal review pass for bugs, security issues, or performance concerns because the skill explicitly excludes those areas.
